explanation: I used WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment() for fragment parsing, next_token() to walk the document token-by-token, get_token_type() and get_modifiable_text() to detect decoded text nodes, serialize_token() to emit normalized token HTML, and is_special() to avoid wrapping special-element opener text. The function wraps whole matching #text tokens in <mark> and returns a normalized serialized fragment.
